id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data spec to configure/retrieve data for the map.

Result data is stored in `data` prop for the React component.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

showFullScreenButton.description:
Show fullscreen button.

This button only makes the "page" to be fullscreen but not the whole map.

enableTerrain.description:
Whenever the map in 3D mode should include "terrain" height or not.

**Note**: This uses Cesium's terrain provider, so it requires a token with valid access.

isDataLoading.description:
Private property that enables the UiSpinner when the data is loading.

Due to how Cesium works, we cannot use set this property after a change in the data.
Since Cesium blocks the UI thread, we need to set this property before the data is loaded.
And then release it when the data is loaded.

zoomedEntity.description:
The entity id of the entity that is zoomed in the map.

The map only reacts to this property when it changes.
